projectAreas.purpose: Application entry points, runtime configuration, package metadata, container configuration, and project-wide documentation.
Repository ownership, issue templates, dependency updates, CI, testing, security scanning, deployment, and release workflows.
Git hooks for pre-commit, commit-message, and pre-push checks.
Public informational pages, contact and service pages, accessibility, sitemap, and error/offline pages.
Authentication, account security, profile, dashboard, applications, counselling, documents, payments, subscriptions, and user support.
Course, college, university, India-study, study-abroad, admissions, and education-resource pages.
Job and internship discovery, employer services, recruitment, resume support, interview preparation, sectors, locations, and career resources.
Administrative interfaces for users, roles, applications, courses, colleges, jobs, documents, payments, subscriptions, support, audit logs, and settings.
Privacy, terms, refunds, disclaimers, cookies, accessibility, data deletion, consent, employer, job-service, payment, and grievance policies.
Frontend CSS and JavaScript, JSON datasets, images, icons, and downloadable public documents.
Public web metadata and well-known endpoints, including robots.txt, sitemap.xml, manifest.json, and security.txt.
SQL schema, ordered database migrations, seed data, and test fixtures.
Storage conventions for private files, temporary files, and logs. Runtime data should be protected and should not be committed.
Backend application modules, configuration, routes, controllers, middleware, services, models, repositories, validation, policies, integrations, templates, workers, and jobs.
Database backup and recovery, capacity planning, monitoring, deployment, rollback, and queue operations documentation and scripts.
Environment checks, database migrations and seeds, data validation, and health-check utilities.
Unit, integration, API, database, security, end-to-end, accessibility tests, and fixtures.
Architecture, API, database, security, deployment, and operations documentation.

documentCollections.purpose: Public educational guides for course selection, eligibility, admissions, applications, and counselling.
Career-development resources including resumes, cover letters, interviews, job search, internships, and workplace skills.
Printable checklists grouped by admissions, applications, career, education, examinations, general tasks, and study abroad.
General guides for education fees, living costs, financial aid, loans, counselling charges, and refund terms.
International education planning guides covering applications, immigration preparation, funding, accommodation, and student safety.

notes: This manifest describes the intended repository structure and does not prove that every listed path exists.
Set an item's status to existing only after checking the repository.
Keep public downloadable resources separate from private user uploads and application records.
The project tree includes both root server.js and src/app.js; document their responsibilities clearly to avoid ambiguous application startup.
Ensure database engine configuration and SQL syntax consistently match MySQL if MySQL is the selected database.
